title: MewCraft!
description: Adds Mewgenics items, npcs, structures and enemies to Minecraft
body:
Are you a Mewgenics fan?
Do you wish there was a Minecraft mod that adds stuff from Mewgenics into it?
Well then you are in luck!
With my janky code, funky models and cool structures, my very close friend and I (tried) to make a mod like that a reality!
(don't expect frequent updates)
Made with Mcreator because i can't code!
